title: Oven Roasted Spanish Ovoli Mushroom Pisto Manchego
description: A sweet and crispy Valencian dish featuring ovoli mushrooms and pisto manchego, perfect for a cozy evening meal. This vegan-friendly recipe is made with a papillote to lock in flavors.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the sliced ovoli mushrooms with olive oil, minced garlic, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Spoon the pisto manchego into the center of a large piece of parchment paper or aluminum foil, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Arrange the mushroom mixture on top of the pisto manchego, making sure to leave a small border around the edges.
Fold the parchment paper or aluminum foil over the filling, creating a tight seal by crimping the edges together.
Place the papillote on a baking sheet and roast in the preheated oven for 25 minutes.
Remove the papillote from the oven and carefully open the packet, taking care not to burn yourself with the hot steam.
Drizzle the roasted mushrooms and pisto manchego with lemon juice and serve hot.
Garnish with fresh parsley or thyme, if desired.
